title: Edgar Mitchell founds the Institute of Noetic Sciences

tellings.quote: Edgar Mitchell was a astronaut who'd been to the moon and into space at least and and he founded the Institute of netic Sciences of which I'm a fellow

plain: Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who went to the Moon, founded the Institute of Noetic Sciences, a research institute devoted to the mind and consciousness. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake mentions this on the show and says he is a fellow of the institute himself, so he speaks as someone inside it.
